_comment: Gesture -> transport map. Tune with detector/calibrate.py. A gesture fires its osc address when its blendshape stays >= threshold for hold_ms, then must drop below release before it can fire again; cooldown_ms blocks re-fire. global_lockout_ms suppresses other gestures briefly after any fire. Higher threshold/hold = less sensitive. Available channels include head pose (lookUp/lookDown/turnLeft/turnRight, tiltLeft/tiltRight) and face (browInnerUp, jawOpen, smile, browUpLeft/Right, winkLeft/Right).
